## Endpoints that do not accept an API key

These operations require a dashboard session (or no authentication, for health probes), so
an API-key SDK cannot call them:

- `GET /healthz` (`healthz`)
- `GET /readyz` (`readyz`)
- `POST /v1/bench/runs/{id}/share` (`mintBenchShare`)
- `DELETE /v1/bench/runs/{id}/share/{shareId}` (`revokeBenchShare`)
- `GET /v1/bench/runs/{id}/shares` (`listBenchShares`)
- `POST /v1/flywheel/candidates/{runId}/accept` (`acceptCostRefusedCandidate`)
- `POST /v1/flywheel/confirmations/{ref}/decision` (`decideCandidateConfirmation`)

- `POST /v1/flywheel/oracles/{id}/rotate-secret` (`rotateOracleSecret`)

- `POST /v1/flywheel/plan/{id}/review` (`reviewLearningPlan`)
- `POST /v1/flywheel/prompt-candidates/{runId}/decision` (`decidePromptCandidate`)
- `POST /v1/flywheel/source-audits` (`openVerdictSourceAudit`)
- `POST /v1/flywheel/source-audits/{id}/grade` (`gradeVerdictSourceAudit`)
